detail: Selected rare subgroup dependency stability; generic agreement is baseline only.

fc_clean_qn will not be used as final independent-replication evidence because cross-study harmonization may inflate agreement.
A 50-permutation synthetic test cannot attain p<0.01 because its minimum corrected p is 1/51; assertion changed to p<0.05. Scientific run remains fixed at 1000 permutations.
A scaled monotonic synthetic series legitimately crosses the -0.5 threshold; the test now verifies contingency completeness instead of incorrectly requiring zero discordant classifications.

Stopped the Project Score 2 combined archive at 68 MB after remote central-directory inspection established it contained combined products; incomplete archive moved to macOS Trash and remains recoverable.
Frozen processing-sensitivity audit before computing any panel-level bf_scaled or bf correlations; MSI-WRN outcomes remain sealed.

First smoke command did not launch the analysis because stdout redirection targeted a missing results directory and status is a read-only zsh variable; rerun changed only shell plumbing.

A newly added known-digest test used an incorrect manually typed expected SHA-256; replaced it with the independently computed digest. Scientific inputs, cohort, thresholds, and outputs were unchanged.
Full frozen run passed discovery and held-out confirmation: Avana delta -0.7432 and KY delta -0.9307, both p=1/100001 with all four tissue effects negative; 16 tests passed.

Auditor exactly reproduced all 147 rows and statistics but found the initial implementation parsed KY endpoint values before the Avana gate and did not verify the sequence-map receipt; strict unseen-held-out wording blocked.

Recorded the protocol deviation, narrowed KY to a sequentially gated confirmation contrast, made endpoint parsing source-sequential, added sequence-map verification and discovery-failure/hash-coverage tests; 18 tests pass.
Added a full run() discovery-failure regression proving only Avana screen IDs are extracted and KY confirmation remains null; final suite has 19 passing tests.
Outcome-blind methods gate required at least 8 paired models per tissue; overlap was Endometrium 5, Large Intestine 17, Ovary 17, Stomach 8. Stopped without computing cross-source WRN ordering.

Frozen a distinct two-tissue ordering analysis with 17 Large Intestine and 17 Ovary overlap models, full source-tissue rank denominators, equal-tissue Spearman mean, stratified inference, and explicit post-unsealing derived-analysis label before computing any model-ordering outcome.
Full frozen run passed all gates: theta 0.5956, p=13/100001, CI [0.2636,0.8114]; colorectal rho 0.8211, ovarian rho 0.3701, and 10/34 gaps >=0.25. Twenty-five tests passed.
Auditor reproduced every point estimate, rank, gap, permutation, and claim label but found bootstrap resamples were re-ranked contrary to the frozen fixed-percentile instruction; existing CI blocked.

Changed bootstrap to correlate sampled frozen percentile values without reranking, added a distinguishing duplicate-sample regression test, and retained all original cohorts, gates, and point estimates.
The new no-reranking test initially used an incorrect manually typed expected Pearson value; corrected it to the independently reproduced 0.8252740455. Scientific inputs and outputs were unaffected.
Protocol-compliant frozen-percentile bootstrap produced CI [0.3186,0.7870]; theta 0.5956, p=13/100001, gaps, and PASS decision remained unchanged. Twenty-six tests pass.

After outcome-blind pseudoreplication/circularity review, froze a 34-model observational association of five-metric source QC-rank asymmetry with WRN-rank gap; 103 unique full-denominator screens, complete metrics, and WRN-excluding control lists verified before association computation.

Full frozen run failed all four outcome gates: theta=-0.0662, p=0.6452, CI [-0.3922,0.2780], and lowest tissue rho=-0.2549. No metric, cohort, threshold, or interpretation was changed after unsealing.

Independent audit returned GO and recommended a non-blocking drift guard; exact equality between all 103 QC ScreenIDs and frozen EXP-003 score ScreenIDs is now enforced, 32 tests pass, and all scientific outputs remain byte-identical.
Both official guide-mutation downloads stalled after partial transfer; incomplete files were preserved and completed with resumable HTTP range requests. Final official MD5 receipts matched exactly.
All 34 outcome-free cohort models had zero mutations at all selected WRN guide locations in both sources; exposure was constant within both tissues, so no association or inference was computed.

Outcome-blind critic approved a model-general discordance audit with common-essential primary and nonessential corroborative panels kept separate, 103-screen complete-gene eligibility, full source-tissue ranks, one median exposure per model, equal-tissue inference, and fixed claim hierarchy before any WRN-gap association.

Before exposure or outcome computation, added the explicitly named EXP-005 WRN-gap file SHA-256 to the manifest and updated the preregistration commit pointer; no method, cohort, threshold, or panel changed.

Full frozen analysis failed the common-essential primary gates (theta=0.1147, p=0.2614, CI [-0.2422,0.4396]) and nonessential corroboration (theta=-0.1078, p=0.7272, CI [-0.4717,0.2683]); all adequacy gates passed and no panel or threshold changed.

After outcome-blind availability and methods review, froze nIncludedSequences source-rank asymmetry as the sole primary exposure; near-duplicate nPassingSequences is sensitivity only, discrete tied-exposure gates are explicit, and no WRN-gap association has been computed.

Full frozen primary analysis failed all four gates: theta=0.0667, p=0.3542, CI [-0.2377,0.3391], and lowest tissue rho=-0.3679. Passing-sequence sensitivity was near-identical and non-rescuing; no tissue subgroup or field was substituted.

Froze an exhaustive guide-level robustness audit before any leave-one-guide-out result: exact 103-score baseline reconstruction, four Avana-only and five KY-only global omissions, full-denominator reranking, and >=8/10 fully robust flagged models as the sole pass criterion.

Frozen included-sequence reconstruction matched 100/103 official WRN scores but failed exactly the three included-greater-than-passing screens; max discrepancy 0.575461. Execution stopped before gap parsing or any of nine guide omissions, and no filter/tolerance rescue was attempted.

Froze a separate post-failure single-candidate semantics audit: exact passing-and-nonexcluded sequence rows, count equal to nPassingSequences, 103-score zero-rtol reconstruction gate, full ledger, no gap-file input, no ranking, and no omission or fallback path.

The sole passing-and-nonexcluded sequence rule reconstructed all 103 frozen official WRN scores; maximum absolute discrepancy 5.551115123125783e-17, all three EXP-010 mismatches resolved, zero new mismatches, and no gap, rank, omission, or robustness analysis ran.

Froze a new child of audited EXP-011 with sequential 103-score and 34-gap baseline gates, strict guide fields, exact four Avana and five KY global omissions, full-denominator average-midranks, exact gap>=0.25 flags, inherited >=8/10 criterion, and no inferential or causal guide claims.

After all baseline gates passed, the exact nine global guide omissions left 5/10 locked WRN gap models fully robust, below the >=8/10 preregistered criterion; six retained across all Avana omissions and six across all KY omissions, with 26 unflagged-to-flagged transitions across 216 possible.

Froze a distinct same-assay association audit: primary full-denominator source-rank discordance in Chronos-inferred model efficacy versus the hash-locked EXP005 WRN gap, descriptive growth-rate companion only, four fixed gates, outcome loaded only after 103-record adequacy, and no causal or cross-experiment rescue claim.

After the source-specific coverage amendment and paired-ModelID adequacy fix, the final run used 17 pairs per tissue, theta=0.2071078431, p=0.1220187798, bootstrap CI [-0.1697118656,0.5334215543], and failed three of four efficacy gates; growth remained descriptive-only.

The source-specific lineage-stratified STAG2-status to STAG1 endpoint direction was negative in Avana and KY, but pre-outcome design power was 0.5070/0.2406 below 0.80 and Avana failed the Liver lineage-consistency gate; no confirmatory replication claim is permitted.

The first EXP015 implementation stopped before endpoint access because it treated a blank lineage in unrelated non-eligible Model.csv metadata (ACH-003132) as invalid; the receipt and correction were preserved.

EXP015 published all five artifacts: Avana delta -0.4582887701 passed 6/6 nominal gates; KY delta -0.2158693116 failed bootstrap-upper-bound and lineage-consistency gates. KY realized design power 0.5787 and frozen planning power 0.5636 both remain below 0.80.

EXP016 completed with all five result artifacts and a reproducible numerical receipt, but the executable canonical-roster design power (Avana 0.8652, KY 0.5875) did not exactly reproduce the frozen candidate-census planning power (Avana 0.8622, KY 0.5699). Frozen preregistration remains unchanged; no clean preregistered or confirmatory claim is permitted.
